item.title: Modest jobs gain in December signals even cooler labor market
item.description: December’s jobs report shows modest growth and a slight drop in unemployment, raising questions for the Fed and housing market.

item.title: Cotality’s Thom Malone on Trump’s proposed institutional investor ban
item.description: Banning large investors could raise rents and limit rental options while having minimal impact on home prices, Cotality's Thom Malone said.

item.title: What Trump’s $200B MBS proposal means for mortgage spreads, rates
item.description: Trump’s $200 billion GSE directive narrows mortgage spreads, with analysts projecting up to 30 bps in tightening.

item.title: ATTOM: Home affordability stays strained across the country
item.description: Home affordability in the U.S. remains below historic norms amid new measures proposed by President Trump to address the crisis.

item.title: Mortgage rates drop below 6% following Trump’s MBS announcement
item.description: Mortgage rates fell below 6% Friday as spreads tightened, aided by Trump’s MBS directive and steady 10-year yields.

item.title: Housing starts fall to lowest point since 2020, led by a stall in the Sun Belt
item.description: Housing starts fell 7.8% year-over-year in October, led by steep declines in the Sunbelt and Mountain West regions.

item.title: Sharp decline in mortgage rates revives hopes of a refi surge, LOs say
item.description: A modest mortgage rate drop may boost refinancing by 15% to 25%, but lenders caution that activity depends on rates staying low.

item.title: Elon Musk says retirement savings could become ‘irrelevant’
item.description: Musk’s perspective stands in contrast to ongoing economic realities for many Americans, especially older adults preparing for retirement.

item.title: Real estate leaders weigh in on potential ban on large investors
item.description: The proposal has sparked debate over the role of Wall Street-backed landlords — and whether restricting them would meaningfully lower prices.

item.title: WSJ: DOJ leadership halted antitrust review of Compass–Anywhere deal
item.description: Compass closed its acquisition of Anywhere Friday, with the Wall Street Journal and Bloomberg reporting that DOJ leaders blocked a deeper antitrust review.
